title: Alcohol-Procedure Excusal Points under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** On Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the alcohol-procedure excusal points are the ID-scan excusal credit, capped at the points the disputed violation was recorded with. The ID-scan excusal credit is the outage credit, used as it stands whatever the shopper's tenure, less the prior-alcohol reduction and less the recent-record reduction, never below zero, where the outage credit, the prior-alcohol reduction and the recent-record reduction are each zero points.

**The disputed violation.** The account's most recent alcohol-procedure violation; its recorded points are the points on that entry.

## Structure of the figure

| Stage | Rule |
|---|---|
| Credit | The outage credit, as it stands: 0 points |
| Reductions | The prior-alcohol reduction (0 points) and the recent-record reduction (0 points) are each subtracted once |
| Floor | A negative figure counts as zero |
| Cap | The excusal points are the lower of the credit and the recorded points |

## Worked example (hypothetical violation)

The most recent alcohol-procedure violation was recorded with 6 points. The credit is 0, less 0 and less 0: 0 points. The lower of 0 and 6 is 0, so the excusal points are 0.
